title: Prove closure-bound activation in a disposable sandbox
goal: After T002 is terminal and independently reviewed, consume its exact immutable implementation revision to prove the managed Nix/NixOS build-and-activation contract end to end inside an exclusively reserved disposable non-production sandbox: realize an exact closure, activate only that approved closure, read it back independently, prove denied paths are effect-free and prove rollback without touching the productive Heim-PC.

approval.note: Runtime mutation is authorized only inside the exclusively reserved disposable service.heim-pc-nixos-activation-sandbox and only after T002 is terminal and its exact implementation revision is independently reviewed. The exact T002 implementation paths are externally reserved for the whole runtime proof so a concurrent writer cannot alter the tested source. Productive Heim-PC activation, boot state, production storage, EFI, Secure-Boot, firmware and reboot remain outside this authority.

acceptance.assertion: Before any runtime effect, the run is bound to the exact terminal T002 source revision and reviewed implementation evidence, and holds external reservations for nixos/deployment, scripts/managed_nix.py and tests/test_managed_nix.py for the whole proof; the checkout/input is read-only for this task and any revision drift, dirty source, lease loss or missing review fails closed.

Before any runtime effect, the run holds the exclusive service.heim-pc-nixos-activation-sandbox claim and independently proves that the target is disposable and isolated from the productive Heim-PC runtime, production storage, EFI, firmware and persistent boot state.

Using only the reviewed T002 implementation and bound inputs, a managed sandbox build realizes an immutable NixOS system closure and emits a receipt binding exact source revision, Control Release Set, effect class and closure.

Sandbox activation consumes only the reviewed managed-build receipt bound to the exact source revision, immutable closure, sandbox target and Activation effect class; mutable source, branch names or caller-supplied closure strings alone cannot authorize activation.

Missing, stale, mismatched or unauthorized source/review/receipt/target authority is rejected before runtime mutation, and evidence proves the denied path leaves the sandbox activation state unchanged.
Independent live readback after authorized sandbox activation proves the running/booted system closure exactly equals the approved closure from the bound receipt.
Observed activation performs no Git, branch, lock or remote-input reevaluation after the reviewed build receipt is fixed; runtime evidence demonstrates closure selection remains receipt-bound.
Inside the same disposable sandbox, rollback consumes the receipt-bound prior closure/recovery path and independent readback proves the expected rollback closure without mutable-source reevaluation.

This task terminates without productive nixos-rebuild switch, productive boot activation, production storage/EFI/Secure-Boot/firmware mutation, Heim-PC reboot or any equivalent production cutover effect.
The exact sandbox build, activation, readback, denied-path and rollback evidence is independently reviewed before T004 is considered terminal.
